title: L'armata s'agapò
creator: Renzo Renzi
subject: Italian occupation of Greece; antimilitarism; military justice; Cinema Nuovo; Renzo Renzi; Guido Aristarco
description: Article published in Cinema Nuovo no. 4 in February 1953. The text dealt with the Italian occupation of Greece and had a strong antimilitarist tone. Its publication led to charges of insulting the armed forces against Renzi and Guido Aristarco, their imprisonment in the military prison of Peschiera del Garda, and a public legal and cultural debate.
format: Manuscript draft and printed periodical article; digital surrogate available through the Cineteca di Bologna Renzo Renzi page
relation: Renzo Renzi Fund; Cinema Nuovo; From Arcadia to Peschiera. The s'agapò trial

depicted_place: Italian-occupied Greece; Peschiera del Garda prison; Italy
